reconcile.note: Gill treats Matthew's 'from that hour' as simply restating Mark and Luke's 'immediately', describing one moment two ways.

sides.snippet: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, \"Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.\" And the woman was made well from that hour.
sides.verseText: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, \"Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.\" And the woman was made well from that hour.

sides.snippet: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
sides.verseText: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
